2115503427979722844.en_summary: @OptionsHawk calls $GMAB "an absolute tank" and says many members have been long all year from his flow and write ups. In the quoted post he said the original December 30 calls were still held, with upside toward 50.

ticker_notes.GMAB: 持有 12 月行使價 30 美元認購期權，上望 50 美元（@OptionsHawk）

2115503873163218945.en_summary: @TheTranscript_ quotes the $AXP American Express CEO saying that, like banks blocking AI assistants, Amex will take a risk based approach and will only allow agents to access its systems if they are approved through API or MCP channels, in order to protect customers and merchants.
2115503873163218945.zh_summary: @TheTranscript_ 引述 $AXP 美國運通行政總裁表示，與一些封鎖 AI 助理的銀行類似，美國運通將採取以風險為本的做法，只允許經 API 或 MCP 渠道核准的代理存取其系統，以保護客戶和商戶。

2115506078314270867.en_summary: @Mr_Derivatives notes $META is down 10 of the last 11 days for a 21% decline, giving back most of September's big gains.
2115506078314270867.zh_summary: @Mr_Derivatives 指出 $META 過去 11 天有 10 天下跌，累計跌 21%，回吐了 9 月大部分漲幅。
